mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, LISTAGG(R.ROLE_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY R.ROLE_NAME) AS roleName FROM PROJECT_MEMBERS PM JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = PM.USER_ID JOIN PROJECT_MEMBER_ROLES PMR ON PMR.PROJECT_MEMBER_ID = PM.PROJECT_MEMBER_ID JOIN ROLES R ON R.ROLE_ID = PMR.ROLE_ID WHERE PM.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND PM.IS_ACTIVE = 'O1' GROUP BY U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME ORDER BY U.USER_ID
